name: Shuvashri Subhasmita Mishra/ଶୁଭଶ୍ରୀ ଶୁଭସ୍ମିତା ମିଶ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Shuvashri Subhasmita Mishra writes poetry in Odia and also signs her work Shelly. Her collection “Agni Saraswati” was published by Black Eagle Books in 2021. The questions in her poems often begin with apparently familiar things—a bird, a tree, the heat of a town—and grow into an argument about whose suffering is seen and whose is left outside the picture.

In “Abhagya Lipi”, injured birds, a fallen banyan and unfinished images unsettle the meaning of misfortune. The poem asks the painter as well as the reader to account for lives omitted from a composition. “Balangir: O Basantia Khara” approaches a beloved city through its almost bodily heat. Welcome, longing and disappointment coexist in a journey whose imagined return remains unfinished.
